preToolUse.command: dotnet run .cursor/hooks/gate/gate.cs --no-build -- guard-write --harness cursor; test $? -eq 0 && exit 0 || exit 2

beforeMCPExecution.command: dotnet run .cursor/hooks/gate/gate.cs --no-build -- guard-version --harness cursor; test $? -eq 0 && exit 0 || exit 2

stop.command: dotnet run .cursor/hooks/gate/gate.cs --no-build -- close-out --harness cursor; test $? -eq 0 && exit 0 || exit 2
